R/Special Criminal Application No.6207 of 2024
 (Quashing)
 =======================================================
 Nirav Divyesh Thakkar(Disposed Of As Not Presed) & Ors.
 Versus
 State Of Gujarat & Anr.
 ======================================================

=
 Appearance:
 Appearance Deleted for the Applicant(s) No. 1,3
 Mr Raxit J Dholakia(3709) for the Applicant(s) No. 2
 Mr Yash L Jain(12802) for the Respondent(s) No. 2
 Niyati D Chauhan(9082) for the Respondent(s) No. 2
 Mr Chintan Dave App for the Respondent(s) No. 1
 =======================================================
 Coram:Honourable Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi

Date : 07/04/2025
 Oral Order
1. With the consent of learned advocates appearing for the parties, present application is taken up for final disposal today.
2. Rule.
Learned advocates appearing for the parties waive service of notice of Rule.

3. By way of the present application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, the 'Code'), the applicant prays for quashing and setting aside the FIR being C.R.
No.11196001240017/2024 registered with Mahila Police Station, Vadodara for the offence NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6207/2024 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and subsequent proceedings pursuant to filing of the chargesheet.

sentences.text: Heard learned advocate, Mr. Raxit Dholakia for the applicant, learned APP Mr. Chintan Dave for respondent no.1 and learned advocate, Ms. Niyati Chauhan for respondent no.2.
I have also heard the respondent no.2 - complainant, who is present before this Court.

Learned advocate, Ms.
Chauhan identifies respondent no.2 and confirms correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by him.

5. When the matter is called out, learned advocates appearing for the parties have submitted that now the dispute is amicably settled between the parties and, therefore, the respondent no.2 has filed an affidavit before this Court, copy of which is placed on record at Page No.40.

Upon making inquiry, the respondent no.2, who is present before this Court, has stated that he has settled the dispute with the present applicant and, therefore, if the impugned FIR is quashed, he has no objection.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6207/2024 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined 6.

Therefore since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through her learned advocate,
the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.
7. Resultantly, this application is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R. No.11196001240017/2024 registered with Mahila Police Station, Vadodara and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said FIR are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicants.
8. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(DIVYESH A. JOSHI, J.) Gautam Nirav Divyesh Thakkar(Disposed Of As ... vs State Of Gujarat on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185823182/
